turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Randall Todd?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Is this still the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: this is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $165.04.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I was in the hospital last month and had no income.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 38 the 17th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $38.08 on July 17. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying the app or banking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
